text:
maria_cs: quick capture from today's Northgrid onboarding call — raw asks below. renewal in ~6w; they said these would affect adoption if not addressed. short bullets then next steps.

maria_cs: pain: embeddings staleness. they push nightly updates but embeddings only refresh with a manual re-ingest. ask: incremental refresh or a lightweight webhook that triggers re-embed on row change. they report ~20% search accuracy drop. called this a blocker for their internal pilot.

maria_cs: pain: per-route cost visibility. they run 8 routes and finance wants simple per-route spend breakdown in the console + CSV export. current token UI too granular for their procurement review. also want annotations for spikes.

maria_cs: pain: private deployment rollout controls. security team requested staged allowlist for model variants (canary -> baseline -> locked). need an API/console knob to pin a route to a model tag during rollouts.

maria_cs: enablement: requested a "jumpstart" one-pager + sample scripts for embedding refresh and cost export (curl + terraform snippet preferred). asked for a ready-to-run example they can hand to SRE.

maria_cs: PM quote: "If we can see cost per route and automate embedding refresh, we can double calls without raising alarms. otherwise it's hard to sell infra."

nina_csm: noting in account and renewal tracker. tagging @sam_product and @kevin_eng. :pushpin:

sam_product: thanks. initial triage: (A) per-route CSV/export — low effort, backend already aggregates tokens by route. (B) embedding refresh webhook — medium, infra design required, auth/rate limits to consider. (C) route->model pin for private — larger, console + rollout work. propose ship A asap, spike B, spec C for Q2.

kevin_eng: agree A is low effort. for B, main questions: webhook auth model and rate limits. options: signed webhook token vs customer-initiated job endpoint. i'll run a 3-day spike to validate. if spike goes well, 2-3 sprints to full impl.

jonah_solutions: i'll draft a minimal jumpstart doc with curl + terraform + tiny lambda example that triggers re-embed on DB change. can ship a prototype to Northgrid for testing.

maria_cs: please treat A as P2 and B as P1 if renewal risk spikes. i'll wait for tickets then update Northgrid with timelines.

ops_bot: reminder: sprint planning tomorrow 10:00am PT — add agenda: "Northgrid: route cost export + embedding webhook spike".

sam_product: action items: maria open three short tickets (labels: cs-customer-ask). I'll add estimates: A patch (2w), B spike (1wk), C spec (Q2).

maria_cs: opening tickets now, will paste IDs when created. :thumbsup:
